name: Drake Perrault
source: Drake is a bully. He and his friends—or, rather, underlings—especially like to pick on Janis because they see her as a helpless girl who can't defend herself. But his friends and victims don't know that, for Drake Perrault, bullying is a way to cope with his condition.
